messages:
Taylor (People Ops): quick q — payroll cutover is 2am Sat. If an employee requests an in-plan Roth conversion this week, should we process before the vendor switch or hold until after? worried about how the old/new vendor will represent pre/post balances for match calculations.
Ben (Payroll): short answer: hold until after cutover if possible. conversions change tax withholdings and the vendors might record them differently, which can complicate YTD match logic.
Priya (Benefits): +1 to holding. also need to confirm whether the match calculation window uses payroll-processed date or pay period end date — vendors differ. send me the employee case and I'll flag it.
Taylor (People Ops): thanks. sending case now — also, do we treat employer HSA contributions that are submitted pre-cutover but posted by new vendor as 'prior year' or 'current year' for vendor statements? employee got confused when their vendor portal showed a small gap.
Marcus (Finance): we book contributions on our side by the payroll date (pay date). vendors should align but some vendor mappings tag deposits by receipt date. that creates portal display gaps even if our GL is fine. we need a reconciliation step in the first payroll cycle post-cutover.
Ben (Payroll): action: we'll pause one-off 401(k) in-plan and manual Roth conversions from now until Tues morning. recurring deferrals and employer match continue as usual. I'll add a note in the payroll run.
Priya (Benefits): for communications: put a short FAQ in the cutover note explaining: (1) one-off plan changes paused, (2) normal deferrals/match process unchanged, (3) any discrepancies will be reconciled within 2 business days. I'll draft.
Payroll Bot: Reminder: payroll cutover window starts 2024-06-08 02:00 UTC — expect vendor portal sync delays for 24-48h.
Taylor (People Ops): perfect. @Ben @Priya can you confirm who owns the employee-facing ticket and recon checklist? I'll reply to the employee and set expectations.
Ben (Payroll): I'll own the ticket intake and initial hold. Marcus — can you own recon checklist with vendor?
Marcus (Finance): yep, will own recon. will coordinate daily totals with Ben and escalate any missing employer contributions.
Priya (Benefits): I'll review the language before it goes out. thanks team. :thumbsup:
Taylor (People Ops): awesome — closing loop here. I replied to the employee to say we are pausing conversions until Tue AM and will reconcile any portal gaps. will post the FAQ in #people-ops and inside the cutover channel.
